theorems.statement: ∀ (n k ℓ : ℕ), ℓ ≤ k → ∀ (U N : Set (Euclid (n + k))) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n), 1 ≤ n → IsOpen U → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 2 (n + ℓ) N → (closure N \ N) ∩ U = ∅ → IsMinimizingIn T (U ∩ N) → T.support ⊆ U ∩ N → BoundaryVanishes T → ∃ E : Set (Euclid (n + k)), (∀ α : ℝ, 0 < α → μH[(n : ℝ) - 3 + α] E = 0) ∧ ∀ x ∈ U \ E, ∃ m : ℤ, HasMassDensity T x m
